# Add photos to an inspection from the phone

> **Status:** Draft
> **Agreed:** not yet
> **Roadmap:** Reports finished on site

## Problem

Site inspectors at property-management companies take photos on their phone, email them to themselves, and attach them to the inspection report from a laptop that evening. Reports go out a day late and photos end up on the wrong report about once a week.

## Outcome

An inspector attaches photos to the inspection report from their phone while still on site.

## Scope

**In:**

- Adding photos to a report in the iPhone app.

**Out:**

- The Android app.
- Video.
- Editing or annotating photos.

## Acceptance criteria

- **A1.** When an inspector taps "Add photo" on a report in the iPhone app and picks a photo from the library, the photo appears in the report's photo list within 10 seconds on a 4G connection.
- **A2.** When the inspector taps "Take photo", the camera opens, and the photo taken appears in the report's photo list.
- **A3.** Each photo in the list shows the time it was added and the inspector's name.
- **A4.** Inspectors using the Android app can add photos to a report the same way.
- **A5.** When the inspector deletes a photo and confirms, it is removed from the report.
